recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a single-file browser game called "Potionmon Sort: No Thoughts Head Empty". Preserve a mobile-first real-time classification loop: items spawn at the top, fall downward, and the player taps one of three large bottom buttons to classify the lowest active item. Correct classification removes it, adds 10 plus combo to score, increases combo and resource slightly, and speeds up gradually. Wrong taps, empty taps, ignored items, and passive decay reduce the resource; resource reaching zero opens a restartable game-over screen.

Theme the experience as a satirical, legally-distinct Pokémon-inspired pastel liquid-sort lab. Use rainbowcore/y2k/pastel dream visuals, a procedural goo mascot, falling goo-card/vial entities, liquid tube background, short meme copy such as "real" and "no thoughts head empty", and mobile-readable HUD terms like SORT XP and brain juice. Keep touch targets large and portrait-first.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
- genre: mobile-first real-time classification arcade game
- objective: tap the matching bottom action for the lowest active falling item before it reaches the action line
- input model: one pointer/touch tap on three large bottom buttons; UI buttons use normal click/tap
- core loop: spawn item at top, fall downward, player classifies by type, correct hit scores and increases combo, wrong/miss/ignored item drains hype
- fail/friction state: hype/brain-juice decays over time and loses 15 on mistakes; game over at 0 with restart

## Protected mechanics
- Three category types, three bottom actions, lowest active falling target selection, score gain of 10 plus current combo, combo reset on fail, hype +5 on success, hype -15 on fail, passive hype decay, speed ramp up to 3x, restart flow, canvas update loop, pointer controls.

## Remix target
The rebuilt game is Potionmon Sort: a satirical pastel liquid-sort lab where legally-distinct goo creatures fall as vial cards and the player classifies them into YEET, KEEP, or REAL tubes. The fantasy changes from chat moderation to rainbowcore/y2k liquid sorting while preserving the source classification loop exactly.
